title: Rabbi Assi of Neharbul
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 87b concerning a halakhah. There, at 136a: “Rabbi Yosa of Neharbul said: Yes, and it was taught, Rabbi Ilai says…” Hyman reports from Dikdukei Soferim that Assi and Yose are one person.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Chullin 87b has Rabbi Assi of Neharbil, and 136a has Rabbi Yose of Neharbil. Hyman supplies Neharbul and Yosa in the latter quotation and reports a proposed identification of the two sages from Dikdukei Soferim; the name forms are not silently harmonized.

The saved digital paragraphs supply Rabbi Assi and Rabbi Yose of Neharbil. Hyman’s Neharbul/Yosa forms and his identification attributed to Dikdukei Soferim remain source-specific reports; no apparatus collation or identity merge is claimed.
